title: Emergence -- Observation
description: The real, flat shape of tick()'s r.observation. FIXED via schema testing: an earlier version of both this schema and loop.js itself only surfaced RelationalModule's summary fields (trajectory, meaning_charge, etc.) -- health and all 9 real Liminal gap signals were computed by rfr2-observer's Gate but silently dropped by loop.js before this was caught. Now flat: summary's own fields stay at the top level for backward compatibility, health and the 9 signals are sibling fields, not nested away.

meaning_charge.description: LIVE -- verified to vary across distinct real text inputs.

decay_score.description: LIVE via sentiment-scorer.js, a NEW domain-agnostic lexicon scorer. Nothing in rfr2 itself produced this signal before that was wired in.

rupture_severity.description: PINNED to a default-derived value -- needs alk.latent.update from a real multimodal source this text-only pipeline doesn't have. Not faked.

negativeSpace.description: What's systematically avoided across a rolling window.

assumption.description: HONEST CALIBRATION NOTE: unlike the other 8 signals, this one's real threshold (hardcoded, not configurable) fires on ordinary unhedged declarative sentences. Verified directly, not a bug. Treat as a much weaker signal than the other 8.

structural.description: The conversation's own implicit power geometry.

existential.description: Identity/meaning concentrated in a single source.

contrastive.description: Stated position vs. what the text is actually doing.

affectiveField.description: Different lineage (vendor/resonance-v5.1, not rfr2). NEVER null -- no abstention mechanism, always computes a closest emotional basin, even on neutral text. Also has a known blind spot: only responds to certainty/hedge/causal/intimacy/empathy/intensity marker words, not common emotion vocabulary ("happy", "furious" alone don't differentiate it). See rfr2-observer/index.js's header and test/affective-field.test.js.

theta.description: {H,I,C,M,P_c,P_e} -- entropy, intensity, certainty, intimacy, compassion, empathy.

emotion_field.description: full 16-emotion ranked field, dominant cluster, dual-pole field_signature if a named pair matches.

gapSignalOrNull.description: null = nothing detected, verified per-module against neutral text. When non-null, real fields observed across modules: id, moduleId, type, subtype, domain, score, confidence, evidence, textExcerpt, loadBearingQuestion. Exact shape varies per module -- see vendor/rfr2/liminal/*.js.
